title: War Room @ Tech Summit
description: You're at the Tech Summit when a customer's VP calls — leaked credentials are running fraudulent Amazon Bedrock inference and the bill is spiking. Join the war-room bridge and advise three AWS frontier agents. Discover, fix, prevent.

learning_recap.title: 🧠 What You Just Learned

cycle.note: AWS DevOps Agent — automated root-cause on operational events
AWS Security Agent (Continuum) — proof-based exploit + fix PR
AWS FinOps Agent — cost anomaly + CloudTrail + owner
You connect the dots across all three

benefits: Frontier agents handle the depth in each discipline
Only the DevOps Agent acts live in the environment (with approval)
Security (Continuum) proves & fixes the code — not live IAM
Human judgment guided the agents and connected all three
You read the incident through disciplines beyond your own
